subject: Telemetry add-on bundle — retention, tracing, dashboards (pricing & pilot)
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@acmecloud.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Telemetry add-on pricing question

Hi Rachel,

Were evaluating telemetry/observability add-ons for the inference layer and want a clearer picture on pricing for three items: retention (30/90/365 days), tracing (full span retention + indexing), and the advanced dashboard pack (real-time + archived replay). Can you share a straightforward packaging proposal and ballpark numbers?

Target: a 6-month pilot across our prod cluster (~150M tokens/month) with potential annual commit if numbers look good. Procurement will need an SOW and a line item breakdown.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Cloud
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-on pricing question

Hi Daniel — great to hear from you. Thanks for the context.

Quick summary attached: pricing by retention tier, tracing ingestion vs indexing, and dashboard pack features. High-level options:
- Pilot bundle (6 months): includes 90-day retention (auto-archive), tracing sample at 10%, full-indexing for critical spans, and the advanced dashboard pack (real-time + replay). Pilot price = $18k/month.
- Annual commit (12 months): 20% off pilot monthly rate, plus a 30% credit on overage tokens for telemetry.
- Seatless metric model is available (flat trace ingestion + storage tiers) — we can map to your token volumes.

Attachments: Redwood_Telemetry_Pack_Pricing_v1.pdf (line items)

If youd like, Ben can outline an alternative packaging that leans into slab pricing instead of monthly meter. Are you able to share a procurement contact so I can include contractual items in the SOW?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Date: 2026-12-03T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing alternative: slab + pilot credits

Daniel — looping in an alternative that some customers prefer for predictability.

Proposal sketch (numbers are monthly):
- Option A (metered): pilot bundle as Rachel proposed = $18k/mo (90d retention). Overage billed at $0.012/token for telemetry events above forecast.
- Option B (slab / committed): commit to 12 months, $13.5k/mo effective ($162k/year) with included 200M telemetry tokens/month and 365d retention for core indices. Overage at $0.009/token.
- Add-ons: full tracing indexing = $3k/mo, advanced dashboards = $4k/mo.
- Concession: 10% one-time onboarding credit for 6-month pilots that convert to annual.

I attached a simple breakdown (bundle_pricing_sheet.xlsx) showing how each line item maps to cost at different volumes. If you prefer, we can model your exact token profile and return a final binding commercial.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Rachel / Ben,

Thanks for the proposals. Procurement asks for the following before we can proceed:
- A firm capped monthly commitment (we need cost predictability).
- 20% discount off list for pilot-to-production transitions — authority: we can approve if tech and legal confirm.
- Confirmation that retention beyond 90 days (to 365) will not trigger additional data residency obligations.
- SOW draft and PO routing contact (we require workday-friendly line items).

Were open to a 6-month pilot, but the finance team wants a not-to-exceed for the pilot. Can you provide a draft SOW and a capped pilot price?

Regards,

Subject: Re: Telemetry add-on pricing question (pilot cap & SOW)

Hi Daniel / Procurement team — thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and a next steps checklist below.

Quoted pilot package (not-to-exceed): $110k total for 6 months (covers pilot bundle at $18k/mo plus a $2k one-time onboarding fee and a 10% buffer for unforeseen telemetry spikes). This is a capped number and we will absorb any overage beyond that cap for the pilot phase.

Annual convert option: convert to a 12-month slab at $162k/year (details in attached SOW). If Acme commits within 30 days of pilot end, Redwood will extend a 15% discount (finalizing at $137,700/year) in lieu of the 20% procurement ask.

Retention/data residency: extending retention to 365 days tiers will not change residency controls; data remains in the chosen region (us-west-2) and KMS-backed. We will document this in the SOW.

Next steps:
- Ive attached a draft SOW (Acme_SOW_draft.docx). Please review the line items and let me know PO routing.
- If acceptable, I will generate a DocuSign link for the pilot addendum. DocuSign: https://docusign.example/s/abcdef123456
- Point of contact for legal: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).

Attachments: Acme_SOW_draft.docx

Looking forward to getting the pilot on the calendar.

Best,
Rachel Kim
